description: Generic entity/user picker with debounced cancellable search, three-state fetch rendering (Ok / Empty / Transient), keyboard navigation, and pointer-down selection so a click registers before blur closes the dropdown. Generic over TUser — no directory/LDAP dependency. Callers supply plain async SearchProvider/ResolveProvider functions that each return an explicit TmPickerFetchState; the component never conflates a transient fetch failure with a genuine empty result, and never bakes in its own retry loop.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Selected user's identifying value (e.g. a login).

parameters.name: ValueChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the selection changes; null when cleared.

parameters.name: SearchProvider
parameters.description: Debounced, cancellable search. Returns items plus an explicit TmPickerFetchState; never bakes in retries — callers own that policy.

parameters.name: ResolveProvider
parameters.description: Resolves Value into a full TUser for display when the value is set externally (e.g. bound from a saved record).

parameters.name: ValueSelector
parameters.description: Extracts the identifying value (e.g. login) from an item.

parameters.name: DisplaySelector
parameters.description: Extracts the display text from an item.

parameters.name: AvatarNameSelector
parameters.description: Extracts the name used to derive avatar initials. Falls back to DisplaySelector when omitted.

parameters.name: AvatarSrcSelector
parameters.description: Extracts an avatar image URL, if any.

parameters.name: MinChars
parameters.description: Minimum characters before a search fires. Default 3.

parameters.name: DebounceMs
parameters.description: Debounce delay in ms before a search fires. Default 300.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Disables the input and hides the clear button.

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: Field label.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: Id of the search input, so the rendered Label can point at it with for. Defaults to a generated value; supply one when the page owns the label.

parameters.name: Required
parameters.description: Marks the field required: the asterisk on the label (tm-input-label-required, the same marker the other inputs use) plus required and aria-required on the search input.

parameters.name: FloatingMenu
parameters.description: Lifts the results list out of the normal flow so an ancestor with overflow: auto — a modal body, a scrolling form column — cannot clip it or scroll it away from its input. The list is then positioned against the input by script, flipping above it when there is not enough room below. Off by default: it costs a JS module import, and a picker that is not inside a scroll container does not need it.

parameters.name: Placeholder
parameters.description: Search box placeholder.

parameters.name: LoadingText
parameters.description: Text shown while a search is in flight.

parameters.name: NoResultsText
parameters.description: Text shown when a search succeeds but finds nothing (State == Empty).

parameters.name: TransientErrorText
parameters.default: Something went wrong. Please try again.
parameters.description: Text shown when a search or resolve fails transiently (State == Transient).

parameters.name: RetryText
parameters.description: Retry button text for the transient-error state.

parameters.name: ClearLabel
parameters.description: Accessible label for the clear-selection button.

parameters.name: ItemTemplate
parameters.description: Overrides rendering of a single result item. Defaults to TmAvatar + display + [login].

parameters.name: EmptyTemplate
parameters.description: Overrides the no-results message.

parameters.name: TransientErrorTemplate
parameters.description: Overrides the transient-error UI. Receives a retry callback that re-invokes whichever provider (search or resolve) just failed.

parameters.name: SelectedTemplate
parameters.description: Overrides rendering of the selected value's chip.

examples.title: Basic user picker
examples.code:
<TmUserPicker TUser="UserDto"
    @bind-Value="_ownerLogin"
    SearchProvider="SearchUsersAsync"
    ResolveProvider="ResolveUserAsync"
    ValueSelector="@(u => u.Login)"
    DisplaySelector="@(u => u.DisplayName)"
    Label="Owner"
    Placeholder="Search people..." />

@code {
    private string? _ownerLogin;

    private async Task<TmPickerSearchResult<UserDto>> SearchUsersAsync(string query, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        try
        {
            var users = await UserService.SearchAsync(query, ct);
            return new TmPickerSearchResult<UserDto>(users, users.Count == 0 ? TmPickerFetchState.Empty : TmPickerFetchState.Ok);
        }
        catch (Exception) when (!ct.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            return new TmPickerSearchResult<UserDto>([], TmPickerFetchState.Transient);
        }
    }

    private async Task<TmPickerResolveResult<UserDto>> ResolveUserAsync(string login, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        try
        {
            var user = await UserService.GetByLoginAsync(login, ct);
            return new TmPickerResolveResult<UserDto>(user, TmPickerFetchState.Ok);
        }
        catch (Exception) when (!ct.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            return new TmPickerResolveResult<UserDto>(default, TmPickerFetchState.Transient);
        }
    }
}
